description: This file is a C header file defining interfaces for JSON handling utilities, including functions for reading and writing JSON data to files. It appears to declare external functions related to JSON processing, conditioned on a specific macro GTEST_ENABLE.

methods.name: readFromFile
methods.description: Reads contents from the specified file path. Declared for testing purposes under GTEST_ENABLE.

methods.name: getArrayNode
methods.description: Retrieves an array node from a cJSON structure.

methods.name: saveToFile
methods.description: Saves a cJSON array node to a specified file with a given format.

methods.name: saveIfNodeContainsLists
methods.description: Saves a JSON node to disk if it contains lists, given an absolute path.

methods.name: iterateAndSaveArrayNodes
methods.description: Iterates over JSON data and saves array nodes to a file.

methods.name: getFilePath
methods.description: Returns the file path currently being used or generated.
